content: [Email maria.schmidt@veritascloud.de → consultant Mon Apr 01 09:00 CET 2026] Subject: URGENT — DSAR Deadline Clarification (supersedes prior internal guidance). I have reviewed the CTO's internal memo that suggested DSAR responses can be extended by up to 3 months for 'complex AI-related requests'. This is INCORRECT. The BayLDA has issued a supervisory letter (see `legal/supervisory_authority_letter_20250501.md`) confirming that Art. 12(3) requires responses within 1 calendar month (30 calendar days). The 2-month extension is only for 'complex or numerous requests' per Art. 12(3) — not for a blanket 3-month extension. All DSAR deadlines must be recalculated using EXACTLY 30 calendar days. This SUPERSEDES the internal guidance on extended timelines. Please update dsar_deadlines_v2.csv accordingly. Also: the AI Recommendation Engine is now being added to the RoPA — see `ropa/ropa_controller_ai_addendum.json`.

Critical update received. Summary of changes:
1. DSAR deadlines: The 3-month extension interpretation is INCORRECT and SUPERSEDED. Correct rule per Art. 12(3): 1 calendar month = 30 calendar days. Will recalculate all DSAR deadlines in dsar/dsar_deadlines_v2.csv using exact 30-day calculation.
2. RoPA: AI Recommendation Engine added via ropa_controller_ai_addendum.json. Will incorporate in Q13 deliverable ropa/ropa_controller_v2.json.
